request: Find a trade-off between upper-body amplitude, wrist tracking and lower-body/root stability.

protocol.formula: q_arm_target=(1-alpha)*q_policy_arm+alpha*q_reference_arm[f+1]; reference converted using original joint scales/default/context. Original final action clamp remains.
protocol.lower_feedback: Frozen RF11 lower14 receive actual closed-loop observations and previous executed action, not replay or synthetic masked inputs.
protocol.ordering: Same ascending-alpha order per repeat; reset-to-reference, not bit-identical hidden solver states or independent repeats.
protocol.comparison: Per-pair common prefixes plus identical per-clip prefix shared by all five alphas; full episode failures, completion, demo steps/peaks/timing retained.
protocol.seed_setting: Original prepare seed0/no observation noise; three physical repeats, not 90 independent motions.

source_plan.protocol: Fixed validation30 + three demos; lower14 always use real closed-loop history. Blended physical upper PD targets: (1-alpha)*policy + alpha*reference[f+1], original action clamp/scale/base retained.
source_plan.lower_control: Frozen RF11 responds to real observations and previous executed actions, not replay or masked sensors.

tests.scope: Exact zero endpoint, reference endpoint, nonuniform scales/nonzero base/intermediate physical targets/lower14 invariance, invalid inputs. Not an improvement claim.

results.pareto_scope: Only the five fixed alpha settings and recorded objectives, using common-prefix error means, worst-repeat validation failures/completion and demo failures. Not a global optimum, independent test, statistical significance or deployment safety certificate.

conclusion.recommendation: Preserve alpha0.75 as a simulation comparison candidate; upper/wrist errors improve and all fixed validation/demos complete in these repeats, at a substantial root-XY cost. Does not meet former <=10% root-degradation rule, does not authorize more training or deployment.
conclusion.future_hypothesis: Frozen teacher plus separate14-dimensional lower/waist residual trained under increasing conditioned upper intervention; ordinary walks retained, separate physical metrics/teacher shifts. Balance-prioritized bounded dynamic-alpha or Q1 dynamics filter need independent calibration/validation.
